projects.title: Drug–Adverse Event Reasoner
projects.description: A multi-source biomedical reasoning system combining RxNorm normalization, CADEC, the Ontology of Adverse Events, SapBERT, FAISS and interpretable graph-path evidence.

projects.title: Code Generation Research
projects.description: HumanEval experimentation across structured reasoning, self-consistency, planning, self-refinement, recursive criticism and test-based enhancement.

projects.title: Agentic RAG
projects.description: A modular retrieval system with document loading, chunking, embeddings, FAISS retrieval, provider abstraction and a LangGraph-based agentic workflow.

projects.title: Bio-inspired Similarity Search & Clustering
projects.description: Experiments extending bio-inspired learning into similarity search and mean-shifted clustering, including an application to fake-news classification.

projects.title: Gradient Ascent Syndicate
projects.description: An open-source effort to build a comprehensive, implementation-first AI/ML curriculum spanning mathematical foundations, classical ML, deep learning, LLMs and agents.

projects.title: AI/ML Newsletter Automation
projects.description: An end-to-end agentic content workflow that collects AI news and research, synthesizes with LLMs, formats output and automates publishing through GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Whitepapers on Enterprise AI
projects.description: Long-form, reference-backed analysis on agents, banking AI, revenue management, responsible AI and the architecture of enterprise intelligence systems.

projects.title: GPT from Scratch — Learning Artifact
projects.description: A transparent educational implementation journey from neural-network primitives through attention, transformers, tokenization, KV cache and a working GPT.
